item.title: Former Liberty-Benton star Lauren Gerken finding stride with BGSU women’s basketball
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — At Liberty-Benton High School, Lauren Gerken’s offensive dominance shaped a legacy among the best in program history.

item.title: Toledo City Council requests more budget cuts in letter to mayor's administration
item.description: Toledo City Council has wrapped up budget hearings and presented its own amendments, but members still aren’t ready to vote on the city’s proposed 2026 budget.

item.title: Presidents Day visit gives students a taste of life at BGSU
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — Coffee, fresh cinnamon rolls, and vegan cookie bars were among the offerings to the throngs of prospective students at Bowling Green State University’s 30th Presidents Day open house.

item.title: Sacramento State officially announced as MAC's newest football program
item.description: The Mid-American Conference officially announced the arrival of Sacramento State as a football-only member Monday.

item.title: Shops at Fallen Timbers under contract to be sold, will be redeveloped
item.description: The Shops at Fallen Timbers is under contract to be sold to a development consortium that promises to add new retail, residential, and restaurant tenants to the shopping center.

item.title: Iran meets UN nuclear watchdog in Geneva ahead of a second round of U.S. talks
item.description: GENEVA — Iran's top diplomat met with the head of the U.N. nuclear watchdog agency on Monday, ahead of a second round of negotiations with the United States over Tehran's nuclear program.

item.title: Rubio plugs Orbán's bid for another term in Hungary's elections
item.description: BUDAPEST, Hungary — U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Monday enthusiastically endorsed Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán 's bid to serve a fifth straight term after the April elections, emphasizing during a visit to Budapest the strong personal relationship between the nationalist leader and U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: 'We are drinking from a fire hose': Archbold tables moratorium vote on data centers
item.description: ARCHBOLD, Ohio — The six-member Archbold Village Council appeared ready to pass a moratorium on hyperscale data centers Monday night but instead opted to table the discussion to look into issues like power generation, interconnection, water usage, and health impacts.

item.title: Editorial: Where’s the effort?
item.description: The Ohio Senate is working on a roadblock to renewable energy projects that is actively hostile to northwest Ohio economic development.

item.title: 3 killed, including suspect, in shooting during Rhode Island youth hockey game
item.description: PAWTUCKET, R.I. — Three people, including the suspect, were fatally shot during a Rhode Island youth hockey game Monday, authorities said.
